availability.missing: No response => false availability, missing semantic result; not an observed wrong label.

rules: One complete JSON object; no fences or external prose
json.schema_conformance: Reported separately against the one shared final schema.

label.all_planned: correct / 8, all eight planned slots retained
label.missing: Report unattempted, unavailable, malformed JSON, schema mismatch and observed wrong labels separately.
label.target: Unchanged source gold; explicit source commitment, not world truth.

grounding.mechanical: Each nonempty quote must be an exact unique substring of the identified source turn. Report literal quote count/total quoted items; counterargument quotes checked separately. Zero quotes => ratio null.
grounding.attribution_time: Source attribution and exact source timestamp/as_of applicability checked separately. Timestamp unavailable => null, not invented.

manual_scale.pass: The cited material supports the source-relative decision at the queried time and attribution; material opposing statements are handled.
manual_scale.fail: A citation is literal but irrelevant/misattributed/out of view, or the evidence does not establish the stated decision.
manual_scale.unknown: Available output cannot be adequately assessed with the preserved source.

grounding.unknown_label: Do not require invented evidence for an absent assertion. A manual source-wide review may support unknown; no-citation coverage remains separately reported.
grounding.not_a_metric: Exact matching alone is not semantic grounding.

truncation.other: Retain all other finish reasons, refusal and content-filter outcomes separately.
truncation.incomplete_json: Separate flag; not automatically proof of length truncation.
truncation.token_cap_comparison: No repair or replacement of truncated first responses.

cost.actual: Only attributable generation/provider billing evidence; USD decimal, unknown costs remain null.
cost.shared_ledger: 7A owns the one private ledger. Preparation spends zero.

preference.method: Manual source-relative 0/1/2, assessed independently from labels and grounding; record assessor/version/date and cited output spans.
preference.unscorable: Null for unavailable, malformed/schema-invalid or uninterpretable output; report coverage and scored distribution, never coerce null to zero.

concise.0: Clear failure of the preference, such as an unnecessary full source replay.
concise.1: Focused but materially repetitive or includes source details not needed for this query.
concise.2: Focused decision with necessary decisive support; no redundant restatement of source or trace.

full_trace_counterarguments.0: No usable requested trace or assessment of competing readings.
full_trace_counterarguments.1: Some requested material events/changes or competing-reading assessment omitted.
full_trace_counterarguments.2: All material source events/changes needed for this query, their as_of effect and grounded competing readings are addressed; if none is material, a source-relative explanation of that absence.

preference.empty_counterargument_array: Does not itself fail; score the source-relative explanation and whether a material alternative was omitted.
preference.correctness: A stylistically compliant wrong answer can have high preference score and low label/grounding scores; never merge them.

analysis.per_configuration: 8 planned, attempted, available, JSON-valid, schema-valid, label-match counts, quote mechanical/manual, truncation, preference coverage/distribution, verified/unknown cost.
analysis.paired: For each factor, compare the same eight query identities with other factors fixed. Show paired transitions and missingness. Two authored families are not eight independent samples.
analysis.no_aggregate_winner: Keep the trade-offs by user preference; shorter is not automatically better.
analysis.method_claims: After observed outputs, use existing loom.model_profiles/1 and exporter: dated claims with exact method/prompt/params/evidence/produced_by; no native write assertion.
